notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes: V1.2. I have made the game easier due to a few complaints about difficulty levels and have added some extra hints etc to find combos which are hidden in the game. Apologies for making the game so difficult, hopefully this will make the experience better

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes: Fixed issues with primary controller input. I was getting feedback that if there was a primary controller that was not a joypad then inputs would not be recognized by a joypad that was not the primary controller. This should be fixed now and the framerate has been capped at 150 FPS as there was a complaint that the framerate was getting up to 400-500FPS at times for some people which was causing high CPU loading.

notes.title: February 2021 Update

Hi Everyone! We’ve been very busy developing Kung Fu Jesus. Craig’s computer “blew up” at one point – and even that didn’t stop us!
